name: BNEF Li-ion pack global avg
notes: BNEF annual survey start. Real 2025 USD per energy-storage.news: $1,474/kWh. Nominal ~$1,160/kWh estimated from 93% decline to 2025 $108/kWh.

name: EOS Znyth Z3 (target price, early 2014)
notes: Eos stated 2014 target of $200-250/kWh with expectation of reaching $160/kWh. Aqueous zinc-bromine chemistry. Not yet commercially deployed at scale at this date.

name: BNEF Li-ion pack global avg
notes: 85% decline from 2010 to 2018. Volume-weighted average across all sectors (EV + stationary).

name: BNEF Li-ion pack global avg
notes: 89% decline from 2010. Some packs already below $100/kWh.

name: BNEF Li-ion pack global avg
notes: 6% YoY decline.

name: Tesla Megapack (list, 100+ units)
notes: First public pricing from Tesla configurator (Jul 2021). 100-unit volume discount price ~$280/kWh. Single unit ~$333/kWh. Hardware only, excludes installation.

name: BNEF Li-ion pack global avg
notes: First-ever YoY increase (+7%) due to lithium carbonate spike and supply chain inflation.

name: Tesla Megapack (list, 10 units)
notes: Mar 2022 price hike. 10-unit pricing $412/kWh (up from $328/kWh in 2021). First supply shortages and raw material inflation. Nevada factory, NMC cells.

name: Tesla Megapack (list, 100+ units, Lathrop LFP)
notes: Sep 2022 updated 3.9 MWh Megapack (up from 2.6 MWh) from new Lathrop CA factory with CATL LFP cells. 100+ unit price ~$475/kWh. Higher price but bigger capacity unit.

name: BNEF Li-ion pack global avg
notes: Resumed decline after 2022 spike.

name: Tesla Megapack (list, Apr 2023)
notes: 1.9 MW / 3.9 MWh unit at $1,879,840 = $482/kWh (Apr 2023 per pv-magazine). Hardware only, no install.

name: BNEF Li-ion pack global avg
notes: Largest drop since 2017 (-20% YoY). Driven by LFP shift, manufacturing overcapacity.

name: BNEF global avg turnkey BESS
notes: BNEF Energy Storage Systems Cost Survey 2024. Global average incl. US and Europe which inflate the mean.

name: BYD LFP cell (utility/grid)
notes: BYD achieved ~$44/kWh LFP cell price through cell-to-pack (CTP) architecture eliminating module layer. Among lowest cell prices globally in 2024.

name: CATL LFP cell (utility/grid)
notes: CATL announced LFP cells shipping at <$56/kWh for grid storage applications in early 2024. VDA-format cells. Vertically integrated supply chain from Li mining through cathode production.

name: NREL US utility BESS benchmark (4-hr)
notes: NREL 2025 Cost Projections for Utility-Scale Battery Storage benchmark for 60 MW 4-hr system. Bottom-up model incl. pack, inverter, BOS, install. US-specific: higher than global avg due to labor and permitting.

name: Tesla Megapack (list, Jul 2024)
notes: 1.9 MW / 3.9 MWh at $1,039,290 = $266/kWh (Jul 2024 per pv-magazine). -44% from Apr 2023. Hardware only, no installation. Shanghai factory now online.

name: BNEF Li-ion pack global avg
notes: Record low. -8% YoY despite battery metal price increases. LFP packs: $70/kWh; NMC: $128/kWh. China avg $84/kWh vs N. America $155/kWh.

name: BNEF global avg turnkey BESS 4-hr
notes: BNEF ESSC Survey 2025: global avg $117/kWh; 4-hr systems $110/kWh, 2-hr $124/kWh. -31% YoY.

name: BNEF stationary storage pack (LFP)
notes: Lowest of any battery segment in 2025. -45% from 2024 ($125/kWh). Pure pack, no inverter or BOS.

name: China Power Construction tender
notes: 16 GWh BESS tender by China Power Construction Corp. 76 bidders; avg $66.3/kWh, 60 bids under $68.4/kWh. Includes supply, system design, install guidance, 20-yr maintenance. Systems to be built 2025-2026.

name: Ember utility BESS all-in capex (ex-CN, ex-US)
notes: Oct 2025 Ember analysis. All-in project capex for large long-duration (4h+) utility BESS outside US and China: ~$75/kWh equipment (Chinese supply) + ~$50/kWh install/engineering/grid. LCOS: $65/MWh at this capex.

name: Tesla Megapack (installed, Q2 2025)
notes: Average installed cost per kWh Q2 2025 per TESMAG estimate. Includes installation. Down from $350/kWh in Q2 2024 (-17%). Tesla energy gross margin ~22%.
